d.ko: Aoba's vibrant cyberpunk world is one of contrasts: high-tech virtual reality battles versus street gang turf wars, ultra-exclusive luxury resorts and tiny junk shops. The choices you make will shape the path of Aoba's journey into the dark secrets lurking beneath the glossy sheen of the city.

d.zh: 《DRAMAtical Murder戏剧性谋杀》所描绘的世界对比十分鲜明，既有高科技的虚拟现实战斗，亦有街头帮派之间的地盘争夺战斗；超豪华的度假村与仿如贫民窟的旧市街道。主人公苍叶游走于这两种极端的世界中，开始了他寻找谜题真相的旅途，而您所做的选择将会决定他与朋友们的命运。
